name: POLYFORGE Geometry Graph
description: Compiles canonical non-destructive geometry DAGs into .forge.json assets. Stable node/link identities, typed sockets, deterministic topological evaluation, cycle and duplicate-input rejection, content checksums, graph editing commands, per-run dependency pruning, and mutation-isolated evaluation caches make procedural assets reproducible. Nodes generate or accept canonical sources, apply stable-ID geometry edits and transforms, configure LOD budgets, measure topology, and expose typed outputs. Authoring only; Asset Baker remains responsible for simplification and GLB export.

implementations.note: Typed ten-node runtime, deterministic graph serialization/editing/evaluation, canonical source generation, transform and budget nodes, content-keyed caching, and direct Asset Baker integration covered by native and independent Python tests.

inputs.name: graphDocument
inputs.description: Validated polyforge.geometry 1.0 document with stable node and link IDs.

inputs.name: sourceDocument
inputs.description: External canonical .forge.json input for source.asset; embedded source.generate nodes need no external document.

inputs.name: graphOperations
inputs.description: Non-mutating add/remove node/link, parameter, and output editing commands.

outputs.name: forgeDocument
outputs.description: Fresh canonical asset evaluated from the graph's asset output.

outputs.name: evaluationTrace
outputs.description: Deterministic node order with per-output asset checksums and measurements.

provenance: Original library-native procedural authoring layer implemented for POLYFORGE; the DAG format, typed compiler, stable graph commands, caching, and original example contain no third-party code or commercial game content.
